_comment: The share frame: the capture overlay MediaCapture draws into the photos and videos the shutter takes, never onto the display - the DimensionX watermark image in the bottom left corner at 60% opacity. The image is the engine's textures/waternark.png, a white logo on transparency named 'watermark' in engine/aliases.json; it is 626x139, so 200x44 pt keeps its shape. The root is shown only while a capture takes it. Sizes in UI points: 1000 across the picture.
